title: Sleighing in Central Park, New York
created_published: United States : Thomas A. Edison, Inc., 1904.
summary: "Showing a large number of people enjoying this favorite Winter pastime in Central Park. This scene was taken close by a large lake, and shows thousands of people skating in the background. A most interesting subject. 100 ft."--Edison films catalog no. 288.
